units.source_text: 一个秋日傍晚，天气微寒。

en.t: One autumn evening, the weather was slightly chilly.

units.source_text: 他因为看到一株玉米，突然联想起这位画家。

en.t: When he saw a stalk of corn, he suddenly thought of this painter.

units.source_text: 生长的高高的玉米，被粗糙的叶子包裹着，土地上露出神经似的细细的根。

en.t: The tall-growing corn was wrapped in coarse leaves, with thin roots like nerves showing above the soil.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，这又是易受伤的他的自画像。

en.t: Without a doubt, this too was a self-portrait of his vulnerable self.
But this discovery made him melancholy.
